rationale: M13 deliberately removes ambiguous research root/error/probe aliases, protects evolving records and explicitly names ExactnessPendingRmhmc. M14 adds named-only modeling/distribution workflows. M15 adds validated reference session/outcome/storage/checkpoint APIs and lossless sampler state access; existing numerical policy is unchanged. No S3/S4 or sampler-default promotion; feature-only Faer fitting remains research. Native NUTS window warmup now drives reference NUTS sessions; frozen checkpoint encoding and stationary reference dynamics are unchanged. New Fisher/static/joint/isokinetic warmup, explicit PSIS reports, full ATLAS and opt-in Newton/reverse diagnostics are reviewed additive research surfaces; RMHMC stays exactness-pending. New research records/enum fields are deliberate pre-release changes. Affine raw support-zero propagation and robust initial L-BFGS line scaling repair smoke failures while preserving strict cache admission and concrete backend errors. Completion adds explicit MAMS trajectory duration and frozen count adaptation, centered MCLMC variance with counted warmup numerical recovery, and separate DRGHMC/ATLAS work partitions. Numerical affine outputs reach the outer checked evaluator; concrete backend errors and coherent cache admission remain strict. Seeded adaptation changes are documented; frozen checkpoint schema is unchanged. Native Enzyme integration adds explicit custom primal metadata, cold Rust source export and an ahead-of-time generated target factory. Higher derivatives are executed through existing capabilities; analytic operation-tape stride, sampler defaults and RMHMC exactness classification remain unchanged. Reference NUTS now caches immutable endpoint velocities and uses private reusable phase slots; sum-once acceptance and deterministic selection branches deliberately change seeded trajectories. Explicit inverse-mass metric types and learned-geometry enum variants avoid dense inversion without reinterpreting existing mass factors. The additive energy/velocity trait method preserves prior default arithmetic and enables factored nonnegative kinetic energy. Frozen checkpoint tags 3/4 encode inverse geometry; legacy tags retain their meanings, and numerics/2 implementation identity deliberately rejects older numerical builds. Reference policy, scientific thresholds and exactness classifications are unchanged. The NUTS performance repair adds an explicit gradient-diagonal warmup builder and a transactional inverse-diagonal setter; covariance defaults and retained kernel contracts remain unchanged. Independent trajectory step jitter, its actual-step observation and an explicit gradient final-restart switch extend the existing NUTS API. Zero jitter retains original RNG consumption; trajectory mixtures freeze their settings before retention. The walltime repair adds checked owned point buffer exchange and finite-value indexing, a factored identity energy override, and an explicit constant-metric endpoint-position turning switch. Runtime SIMD does not contract kick/drift arithmetic; nonnegative kinetic reductions use bounded nonsequential sums. Covariance and generalized turning remain constructor defaults. The checkpoint implementation identity increments to numerics/3 because high-dimensional momentum generation and kinetic reductions change replay streams; numerics/2 checkpoints are rejected while earlier draw data remains readable.
